Subject: Post-demo: Data TTL, Backup Restore SLA & SOC2 evidence request

Hi Arielle —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few asks so we can move the evaluation forward with your security and legal teams:

1) SOC 2 / compliance status
- You mentioned SOC 2 Type II is in progress for Q3. Can you confirm whether you already have a SOC 2 Type I report or any interim evidence we can share with our internal compliance reviewers?

2) Data retention & deletion (primary concern from Legal)
- Please confirm the desired retention window for user content and logs: options you called out were 30 / 90 / 365 days. If you have a formal retention policy URL or internal doc, please share.
- Clarify whether you need deletion guarantees from backups and long-term snapshots (i.e., when a record is deleted in-app, how quickly should it be purged from backups/snapshots and what proof is sufficient).

3) Backup & restore SLA (ops question)
- Do you have a preferred RTO/RPO for restores from backups? For context, Redwood offers tiered restore SLAs for Dedicated customers (e.g., RTO up to 4 hours, RPO configurable) — we can propose a match depending on tier.

4) Vendor security questionnaire
- To accelerate the legal review, would you like us to start and return your VSA questionnaire? We can either complete your questionnaire directly or provide a short package: SOC summary, encryption attestations, key retention/rotation notes, and our standard retention matrix.

Attached: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (stub) and a draft retention-ttl-matrix.xlsx that maps items to backups/snapshots.

Suggested next steps:
- If you want us to complete your vendor questionnaire, please send the doc or link.
- If helpful, we can set a 30-minute call with Ben (security lead) and our infra engineer to walk through backup mechanics and timelines — propose Wed 4/28 9:00–9:30 PT.

Thanks — we want to make sure the retention/deletion path is explicit for your auditors.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa —

Really helpful recap, thanks. Short answers below and a couple of asks from our side.

SOC 2: we have a Type I from last year and are mid-process for a Type II audit (report expected Q4). For the Legal team, a Type I and our SSAE engagement letter would help for now.

Retention: our default is 90 days for application-level user content and 365 days for audit logs, but Legal is open to tiering for PII-limited datasets. We need explicit language about backups/snapshots: when a record is marked deleted, it must be removable from backups within our agreed SLA or we need a compensating control.

Backups & restores: we typically require RTO <= 12 hours for non-prod data and RTO <= 6 hours for production critical systems; RPO targets are 1–4 hours depending on the data classification.

Questionnaire: attaching link to our vendor security intake: https://mediportal.secure/vsa/start (we'll share a tokenized link). Please complete the VSA, or we can take your SOC summary and fill key sections first.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood confirm encryption at rest for backups and whether customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) are supported for encrypted backups?
- Please confirm whether Redwood retains logical deletion logs for at least 30 days after deletion to support audit requests.

We can do the security call on Thu 4/29 10:00–10:30 AM ET if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Arielle Moskowitz
Director, Platform Security
MediPortal

Arielle —

Thanks for the quick reply and the VSA link. A few clarifications from our side to help Legal/Security map to contractual language: 

1) Deletion guarantees & backups
- For hosted/managed customers on our standard Tier, backups are daily snapshots retained for 30 days by default; archives are retained up to 90 days. For Dedicated customers (reserved capacity), we support configurable retention up to 365 days with SLA-backed deletion windows.
- When an object is deleted in-app, Redwood removes it from the active dataset immediately. For backups/snapshots, we offer a documented purge process: we can either (A) provide a documented retention window and attest when backup data reaches end-of-life, or (B) provide a cryptographic key-rotation path that renders older encrypted blobs unrecoverable within the agreed deletion SLA. If you require cryptographic unrecoverability as proof, we can support CMK (customer-managed keys) and key destruction workflows.

2) RTO / RPO examples (can be included in SOW)
- Non-prod: RTO <= 12h, RPO <= 4h (default)
- Prod standard: RTO <= 6h, RPO <= 1h (Dedicated can go lower)
- Dedicated high-availability: RTO <= 4h, RPO <= 15m
3) Encryption
- All persisted data and backups are encrypted at rest using AES-256. We support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) for Dedicated and Private deployments.

4) Logical deletion logs
- We retain an append-only deletion-log record for 90 days by default, with a 30-day accessible window for audit retrieval. If Legal needs a longer audit trail, this is configurable and we'll note it in the SOW.

Next steps we propose:
- We'll complete the MediPortal VSA using the link; expect a first-pass draft in 48 hours (we'll populate SOC/crypto/retention answers).
- If you need cryptographic evidence of deletion from backups, let's flag that in the contract and outline the CMK destruction workflow in an addendum.
- Confirm a time for the security deep-dive: Thu 2027-04-29 10:00 AM ET works for Ben and our infra lead.

Pinged Priyom to start filling the VSA and attach the retention matrix.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Solutions Security, Redwood Inference
